text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their second Summer Training Camp begins. 
With all doubts cleared away, Fine Motion 
intends to enjoy the training camp with 
all her might.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how she was doing, Air Shakur 
seemed to have made up her mind to move 
forward as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Sapporo Kinen was also right around 
the corner during camp. Fine Motion 
dedicated herself to training with a 
renewed sense of resolve!
